description: Na₂Al₂S₃(O₃Cl₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two O and four Cl atoms. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.11 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to three O and three Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₃O₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent AlCl₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.42 Å. There are two shorter (2.92 Å) and one longer (3.01 Å) Na-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four Cl atoms to form AlCl₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaCl₃O₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-73°. There are two shorter (2.16 Å) and two longer (2.17 Å) Al-Cl bond lengths. In the second Al site, Al is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four Cl atoms. There are three shorter (2.16 Å) and one longer (2.17 Å) Al-Cl bond length. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both S-O bond lengths are 1.45 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both S-O bond lengths are 1.45 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both S-O bond lengths are 1.45 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. There are eight inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Al atom. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the seventh Cl site, Cl is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the eighth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Al atom.
